blocks.text: ● Machines and pilots can each equip 3 {o|Abilities}. Change them with the Intermission {o|"Ability"} command. If 3 or more of the same Ability are among the 6 slots of a machine and its main pilot, you get an Ability effect, such as more damage or a higher hit rate.
● For a Twin Unit, the 12 slots of both machines and their 2 main pilots count, and both machines get the Ability effect.
● Abilities are bought and sold with {o|"AP"}, earned in battle, using the Intermission {o|"Buy Abilities"} and {o|"Sell Abilities"} commands.
If an Ability totals fewer than 3, it is wasted. If it totals 4 or more, any beyond 3 are wasted.
